name: once-upon-a-diff-workspace
description: A code-review story in a side panel on top of a diff: a Chrome extension for GitHub PRs, plus a local bridge that also serves local commits

scripts.depcruise: depcruise --config configs/.dependency-cruiser.mjs packages/bridge/src packages/bridge/bin packages/bridge/instrumentation packages/web/public packages/panel/src packages/panel/types packages/host-github/src packages/api-client/src packages/ui-kit/src packages/protocol/src packages/domain/src packages/extension/src packages/test-kit/src
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspaces foreach --all --exclude once-upon-a-diff-workspace -v run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: yarn workspaces foreach --all --exclude once-upon-a-diff-workspace -v run test
